# The Pharma Coach

The Pharma Coach helps ambitious professionals position their existing experience for careers in pharmaceutical and medical-device sales.

## Blog

The /blog index lists Jebb's published posts. Every post is hosted on this site at /blog/<slug>. Posts adapted from Jebb's social video link to the original clip.
